newsitem.title: USA: American Eco backs off warrant offering.
newsitem.headline: American Eco backs off warrant offering.

text.p: American Eco Corp said on Friday it will not complete a special warrant offering to raise up to the equivalent of US$58 million in Canadian funds to acquire Chempower Inc.
American Eco President and Chief Executive Michael McGinnis said in a statement that at current market levels, the offering "is not possible."

"In our view, the recent unexpected decline in the market price of our common shares is not justified," he added. "...We have withdrawn the Canadian special warrant offering because at current market levels it would adversely dilute" the stock.
The company said it remains interested in the Chempower merger and is moving ahead with negotiations to complete the deal.
The special warrant offering had been announced September 20.
